title: Not Because of Righteousness

questions.question: Why was Israel going to possess the land?
options: Not because of their righteousness, but because of the wickedness of the nations
questions.correctAnswer: Not because of their righteousness, but because of the wickedness of the nations
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 9:5 (ESV): "Not because of your righteousness... but because of the wickedness of these nations..."

questions.question: What kind of people did Moses call Israel?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 9:6 (ESV): "...for you are a stubborn people."

questions.question: What did the people make at Horeb that provoked God?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 9:16 (ESV): "...you had made for yourselves a golden calf..."

questions.question: How long did Moses stay on the mountain specifically mentioned here?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 9:9 (ESV): "...I remained on the mountain forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water."

questions.question: What did Moses do with the two tablets when he saw the sin?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 9:17 (ESV): "So I took hold of the two tablets and threw them out of my two hands and broke them before your eyes."

questions.question: Who are the Anakim?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 9:2 (ESV): "a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim..."

questions.question: What did God want to do to Aaron?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 9:20 (ESV): "And the Lord was so angry with Aaron that he was ready to destroy him..."

questions.question: How did Moses destroy the calf?
options: Burned it, crushed it, and threw the dust into the brook
questions.correctAnswer: Burned it, crushed it, and threw the dust into the brook
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 9:21 (ESV): "Then I took the sinful thing... and burned it with fire and crushed it... until it was as fine as dust..."

questions.question: Besides Horeb, where else did they provoke the Lord?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 9:22 (ESV): "You also provoked the Lord at Taberah and at Massah and at Kibroth-hattaavah."

questions.question: What did Moses pray lest the land say?
options: "Because the Lord was not able to bring them in..."
questions.correctAnswer: "Because the Lord was not able to bring them in..."
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 9:28 (ESV): "lest the land from which you brought us say, 'Because the Lord was not able to bring them into the land...'"

questions.question: How is God described as passing over before them?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 9:3 (ESV): "...he who will go over before you as a consuming fire is the Lord your God."

questions.question: What phrase is used to describe their rebellion "rebellious against the Lord"?
options: From the day you came out of the land of Egypt until you came to this place
questions.correctAnswer: From the day you came out of the land of Egypt until you came to this place
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 9:7 (ESV): "Remember and do not forget... from the day you came out of the land of Egypt... you have been rebellious against the Lord."

questions.question: God offered to make a nation out of Moses that was what?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 9:14 (ESV): "...and I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they."

questions.question: For whom did Moses verify he prayed for specifically alongside the people?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 9:20 (ESV): "...And I prayed for Aaron also at the same time."

questions.question: What did Moses not do during the 40 days and nights?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 9:9 (ESV): "...I neither ate bread nor drank water."

key_verse_text: Know, therefore, that the LORD your God is not giving you this good land to possess because of your righteousness, for you are a stubborn people. (ESV)
